thread:
Aisha: Quick heads-up — Holloway Retail renewal in 28 days. Usage down ~60% over last 30d, only 2 active seats last week. They responded to the CS survey: "platform feels clunky, onboarding incomplete". Need a 7-day save plan and a downgrade-safe path if they still want lower spend.
Ben: Got it. I can lead the outreach. Can we draft a short remediation + offer? Suggested: 10% off next 3 months or free enablement session.
Liam: +1 on free enablement. Also suggest feature-scoped demo for their power users (reduce perceived complexity). Who can pull telemetry showing which features they used?
Aisha: Tracey — can you pull usage heatmap (last 90d) and top 5 failed flows? Need by EOD today.
Tracey: On it. Will share a compact CSV and a 3-bullet summary. Any specific flags? (errors, slow LLM calls, frequent retries)
Aisha: prioritize errors and high-latency endpoints. Also capture first successful flows for onboarding benchmarks.
Ben: Draft outreach copy (short):

  "Hi <AccountOwner>,
  We noticed activity dipped and wanted to check in. Would a 30-min enablement call + a complimentary 10% credit for the next 3 months help get things back on track? We can also propose a lightweight downgrade path that preserves your key automations.
  —Aisha / Redwood CS"

Liam: Love the brevity. Add a concrete next step: "Pick a 30-min slot this week" + link to calendar.
Aisha: Good call. Ben, can you send by tomorrow? We want to pair the message with the analytics packet.
Ben: I’ll send and set follow-up reminders (2 days / 7 days). Also proposing two save tiers in the email: 1) Enablement + 10% credit (preferred), 2) Downgrade-lite: keep 1 production routing + lower concurrency, prorated credits.
Tracey: Uploaded files: "holloway_usage_90d.csv" and "holloway_quick_findings.md" to the shared folder. Top issues: 1) Onboarding flow 3 drop-off, 2) 80th percentile latency spikes on /api/generate at peak, 3) no follow-up success checks in 60 days.
OnboardBot: Reminder set — outreach due 2023-11-15 10:00 UTC. Follow-ups scheduled 2023-11-17 and 2023-11-22.
Aisha: Parallel asks for Product: Liam, can you escalate the latency spikes to infra? If there’s a quick config (batching or quota bump) we can offer a temporary uplift during the enablement call.
Liam: Filing a priority ticket with eng-infra, tagging with "HOLLOWAY-URGENT". ETA for initial triage 24h.
Ben: Created two templates for the downgrade-safe config: one that preserves rule-based automations, one that removes non-critical scheduled jobs. I’ll attach both options in the email so they can pick.
Aisha: Great. Success metrics for the save: +25% active seats or signs of resumed automation in 30 days. If not met, route to formal downgrade with clear data and a checklist of critical flows to preserve.
Tracey: Adding friction metrics and expected regression if downgrade path chosen. Will include instructions for partial rollback.
Ben: Outreach sent. cc Aisha. If no reply in 48h we escalate to AE and Solutions Eng.
Aisha: Thanks team. After outreach, capture customer responses and update the shared doc. Also log the play result: saved / downgraded / churned. We’ll iterate the playbook based on outcomes. :thumbsup:
